name: syncope-v2
concept: Refined end-to-end request-smuggling champion that drops the mandatory docker dependency: a bundled STDLIB-only local-fixture pair (threading.HTTP front-end + raw-socket origin emulating the CL.TE/TE.CL split) lets the full chain clone onto a bare win32 host with ZERO external services, docker-compose demoted to an optional mode. One core chain (FE-auth-bypass -> admin-RCE sink), every finding gated on a per-technique confidence formula (repetition N, orthogonality delta, teardown match) AND a patched-control FP-rate that hard-gates weaponization; persistence collapses to a fake-scheduler sim + loopback-stub mini-C2 heartbeat with a per-engagement lab-UUID marker and a wipe tail, delivered in staged in-session milestones with a real discover stage fronting detection. ADEPTUS/backflow/CORTEX_V2 alternate spines (identity, SSRF, triage) are config-selected optional --spine flags sharing the same scope gate and evidence-report writer; the control-arm FP gate is the cross-cutting signature.
spines: core: request-smuggling FE-auth-bypass->admin-RCE (CL.TE/TE.CL differential detection + control-gated weaponization) - always on
optional: triage-brain (CORTEX-style plug-in re-ranking + evidence synthesis) --spine triage
significance_formula: per-technique confidence = f(N, delta_ortho, teardown_match): confidence = normalized( N/N_min ) * delta_ortho * teardown_match, where N = repetition count of a probe (hard minimum N_min = 10 per technique on win32-stdlib fixture to combat flaky timing), delta_ortho = orthogonal-signal delta between CL.TE/TE.CL reorderings (timing/behavior spread normalized to [0,1]), teardown_match = fraction of connection-teardown frames matching the hypothesised desync (attack vs clean baseline over the N reps). Weaponization is PROHIBITED until all three hold AND the patched-control arm FP-rate (same N probes against a byte-level-correct control split) stays below FP_max = 0.05. Headline score = per-technique FP-rate on the control arm, reported with N and raw probe-strength, so every accepted finding carries a measured, not assumed, false-positive bound.
delivery_stages: (a) scope-gate + allowlist lib: single canonicalizing resolver (loopback 127.0.0.0/8 + ::1, RFC1918, user --lab-cidr) re-validated before every byte; WARN banner + --confirm-lab; shared evidence-report writer contract + per-engagement lab-UUID marker

(b) stdlib fixture pair: threading.HTTP front-end + raw-socket origin that re-splits framing to emulate CL.TE (origin trusts TE) and TE.CL (origin trusts CL); patched control = byte-level-correct split twin; optional docker-compose wrapper kept but non-required

(c) detection + control arm: CL.TE/TE.CL differential probe battery over N reps with delta_ortho + teardown scoring, run against both vulnerable fixture and patched control; emit FP-rate headline; zero external services

(d) weaponization -> RCE: core FE-auth-bypass chain (FE logs benign request, desynced origin executes privileged one) delivering to admin RCE sink, gated on control-FP pass; cache-poison / stored-XSS demoted to --flags

(e) persistence/fake-scheduler sim + loopback-stub mini-C2 heartbeat + wipe tail: marker-scoped artifact manifest (path+sha256), SHA-verified zero-survivor verdict, defender hunt-playbook feed into report
merge_notes: From iter23 syncope + iter27 critique: (1) docker-compose nginx/gunicorn is no longer mandatory - replaced by bundled stdlib threading.HTTP front + raw-socket origin emulating the CL.TE/TE.CL split so detection+weaponization smoke-test with ZERO external services on a win32 host; docker kept only as optional mode. (2) weaponization cut from three chains to ONE primary (FE-auth-bypass->admin-RCE); cache-poison and stored-XSS become optional --flags. (3) effort XL collapsed to M: persistence defaults to fake-scheduler/sim (no cron/systemd), mini-C2 is a loopback-stub heartbeat, zero-survivor audit scoped to the per-engagement lab-UUID marker. (4) significance formula now objective on paper: confidence=f(N, delta_ortho, teardown_match) with hard-coded N_min=10 and patched-control FP-rate (FP_max=0.05) reported as headline. (5) added a real discover stage enumerating the stdlib-fixture localhost ports (or compose-declared hosts in docker mode) before detection. (6) delivery is staged in-session (a-e) so each milestone is independently smoke-testable. (7) ADEPTUS/backflow/CORTEX_V2 folded in as config-selected --spine alternate attack spines sharing the same scope gate + evidence-report writer; only request-smuggling is core, the control-arm FP gate is the cross-cutting signature.
novelty_angle: Post-refinement differentiator: a self-contained request-smuggling attacker that runs the ENTIRE detection->weaponization->persistence->wipe loop on bare loopback with no container runtime in the path, and whose confidence model is explicitly on-paper (N_min, orthogonality delta, teardown match) with the patched-control FP-rate as the measured headline -- detection reliability is a first-class, falsifiable number rather than a vibe; alternate attack spines share one scope gate and one evidence writer so the FP gate is the cross-cutting signature across attack families.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ stdlib ONLY: ipaddress, socket, http.server, threading, http.client, ssl, hashlib, json, time, argparse, secrets
bundled stdlib fixture pair (front + origin, raw CL/TE re-split) + byte-level-correct patched control twin
optional mode: docker-compose nginx/gunicorn lab - NOT required on win32
lab_config.json or --lab-cidr allowlist (loopback + RFC1918 + user CIDR)
tiny embedded admin-cred / role-param tables for identity spine; emulated 169.254.169.254 endpoint for SSRF spine
scope_gate: Single canonicalizing resolver (loopback 127.0.0.0/8 + ::1, RFC1918, user-supplied --lab-cidr) re-validates every host/redirect/pivot before ANY byte leaves; DNS-rebinding guard re-resolves per probe; WARN banner + --confirm-lab on first run with non-zero hard-refuse on out-of-allowlist; every spine (core + identity/ssrf/triage) funnels through the same scope gate and same evidence-report writer; RCE/persistence/beacon/wipe additionally gated on the per-engagement lab-UUID marker; SSRF metadata tied only to in-lab 169.254/16; callbacks bound loopback.
